title: Two Roblox games built around talking your way out
summary:
Two community-made Roblox escape games joined the Games list, which also got some overdue weeding.

The Games list added Convince the Weird Maid to Let You Leave the House and Aiko AI: With You Til The End. Both turn conversations with AI characters into escape-room mechanics: one has a rising “freakiness” meter; the other has a character whose emotional state responds to what players say.

Mindcraft’s listing now points to its web game, and Irina’s listing has a different URL.

The project list consolidated Mindcraft’s duplicate entry, removed duplicate AI drafterplus and Pollinations MCP Server listings, and removed Favorite Puzzles and Watch TV with Neko from Games.

daily.title: Two AI escape games
daily.text: Try two community-made Roblox games where what you say to an AI character shapes your attempt to escape. [Explore community projects](https://pollinations.ai).
